reviewSamples.author: Photo of Christine Matthews
reviewSamples.text: Mr Ferris did an absolutely wonderful job moving my friend's furniture for me. He also did it the day of, very short notice. I would highly recommend him and his company to anyone looking to get the job done in a professional, proficient, and reasonable manner. I can say from experience that they are the best!!!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Jay M
reviewSamples.text: Ferris and his team were extremely polite, respectful and careful with the furniture to be moved.  They worked quickly but carefully and followed any directions and requests in a professional manner.  We were very impressed with this business and will definitely use them again when we have a need.
